scenes.location: Floating Volcanic Islands Above a Neon Planet

dialogue.speaker: Dragon_Arinthal
dialogue.line: You trespass in my skies, creature of the void. State your purpose.
dialogue.visual_cue: Wide cinematic shot of a massive dragon perched on a lava-cracked floating island, glowing wings spread against a cosmic sky

dialogue.speaker: Zorvath
dialogue.line: I come not as an enemy, but as a seeker. Your world holds the energy core my species desperately needs.
dialogue.visual_cue: Close-up of Zorvath, a bioluminescent alien with shifting patterns across its skin

scenes.location: Ancient Crystal Cavern Beneath the Islands

dialogue.speaker: Zorvath
dialogue.line: These crystals… they resonate with unimaginable power.
dialogue.visual_cue: Tracking shot through glowing crystals reflecting vibrant colors across the cavern walls

dialogue.speaker: Dragon_Arinthal
dialogue.line: They are the heart of this world. Remove them, and everything above will fall.
dialogue.visual_cue: Low-angle shot of Dragon_Arinthal looming protectively over the crystals

scenes.location: Cliff Edge Overlooking a Cosmic Storm

dialogue.speaker: Zorvath
dialogue.line: Then help me find another way. I will not doom your world… but I cannot let mine perish either.
dialogue.visual_cue: Medium shot of Zorvath extending a glowing limb, storm lighting flashing in the background

dialogue.speaker: Dragon_Arinthal
dialogue.line: Perhaps there is a path neither of us can see alone.
dialogue.visual_cue: Epic wide shot of both characters silhouetted against a swirling cosmic storm
